# SkillVault Uninstall

Uninstall installed skill folders by index, range, comma list, keyword, or skill name after
showing matches and confirming deletion.

Examples:

```text
/skillvault-installation uninstall 2
/skillvault-installation uninstall 1,3-5
/skillvault-installation uninstall web-design-guidelines
/skillvault-installation uninstall investigate project
```
